headline: Maintenance Technician
workPreference: Manufacturing & Production, Warehouse & Fulfillment, Skilled Trades & Industrial, Customer Service & Events
summary: Experienced tradesperson with a long background in carpentry, construction, maintenance, and technical repair work. Skilled in framing, finish carpentry, property and apartment maintenance, and equipment installation, with a hands-on approach to problem-solving and a comfort working independently or as part of a team.
